import os
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)]
    p1=[p for p in pts if g[p[0]][p[1]]==1][0]
    p2=[p for p in pts if g[p[0]][p[1]]==2][0]
    di=1 if p2[0]>p1[0] else -1
    dj=1 if p2[1]>p1[1] else -1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    i,j=p1
    # diagonal until one row away from p2's row (target row on the approach side)
    ti = p2[0]-di
    while i!=ti:
        i+=di; j+=dj
        out[i][j]=3
    # horizontal until one col before p2's col
    tj=p2[1]-dj
    while j!=tj:
        j+=dj
        out[i][j]=3
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts={(i,j):g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)}
    p1=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==1][0]
    p2=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==2][0]
    si = 1 if p1[0]>p2[0] else -1
    sj = 1 if p1[1]>p2[1] else -1
    P=(p2[0]+si, p2[1]+sj)  # diag neighbor of 2 toward 1
    Q=(p1[0]-si, p1[1]-sj)  # diag neighbor of 1 toward 2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    segs=[]
    # horizontal-straight then diagonal
    di=Q[0]-P[0]
    c=Q[1]-sj*abs(di)
    if min(P[1],Q[1])<=c<=max(P[1],Q[1]):
        segs.append([('h',P[0],P[1],c)])
    # vertical-straight then diagonal
    dj=Q[1]-P[1]
    r=Q[0]-si*abs(dj)
    if min(P[0],Q[0])<=r<=max(P[0],Q[0]):
        segs.append([('v',P[1],P[0],r)])
    seg=segs[0]
    if seg[0][0]=='h':
        _,row,ja,jb=seg[0]
        step=1 if jb>ja else -1
        for j in range(ja,jb,step): out[row][j]=3
        cur=(row,jb)
    else:
        _,col,ia,ib=seg[0]
        step=1 if ib>ia else -1
        for i in range(ia,ib,step): out[i][col]=3
        cur=(ib,col)
    stepi=1 if Q[0]>cur[0] else -1
    stepj=1 if Q[1]>cur[1] else -1
    i,j=cur
    while (i,j)!=Q:
        i+=stepi; j+=stepj
        out[i][j]=3
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts={(i,j):g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)}
    p1=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==1][0]
    p2=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==2][0]
    si = 1 if p1[0]>p2[0] else -1
    sj = 1 if p1[1]>p2[1] else -1
    P=(p2[0]+si, p2[1]+sj)
    Q=(p1[0]-si, p1[1]-sj)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    di=Q[0]-P[0]; dj=Q[1]-P[1]
    c=Q[1]-sj*abs(di)   # horizontal-straight then diagonal
    r=Q[0]-si*abs(dj)   # vertical-straight then diagonal
    if min(P[1],Q[1])<=c<=max(P[1],Q[1]):
        step=1 if c<P[1] else -1
        for j in range(P[1],c,step): out[P[0]][j]=3
        cur=(P[0],c)
    else:
        step=1 if r<P[0] else -1
        for i in range(P[0],r,step): out[i][P[1]]=3
        cur=(r,P[1])
    stepi=1 if Q[0]>cur[0] else -1
    stepj=1 if Q[1]>cur[1] else -1
    i,j=cur
    while True:
        out[i][j]=3
        if (i,j)==Q: break
        i+=stepi; j+=stepj
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts={(i,j):g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)}
    p1=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==1][0]
    p2=[p for p,v in pts.items() if v==2][0]
    si = 1 if p1[0]>p2[0] else -1
    sj = 1 if p1[1]>p2[1] else -1
    P=(p2[0]+si, p2[1]+sj)
    Q=(p1[0]-si, p1[1]-sj)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    di=Q[0]-P[0]; dj=Q[1]-P[1]
    c=Q[1]-sj*abs(di)
    r=Q[0]-si*abs(dj)
    if min(P[1],Q[1])<=c<=max(P[1],Q[1]):
        step=1 if c>P[1] else -1
        for j in range(P[1],c,step): out[P[0]][j]=3
        cur=(P[0],c)
    else:
        step=1 if r>P[0] else -1
        for i in range(P[0],r,step): out[i][P[1]]=3
        cur=(r,P[1])
    stepi=1 if Q[0]>cur[0] else -1
    stepj=1 if Q[1]>cur[1] else -1
    i,j=cur
    while True:
        out[i][j]=3
        if (i,j)==Q: break
        i+=stepi; j+=stepj
    return out
